label: Figma
description: Arcade tools designed for LLMs to interact with Figma

tools.name: AddCommentOrReply
tools.description:
Add a comment to a Figma file or reply to an existing comment.

If parent_comment_id is provided, creates a reply to that comment.
Otherwise creates a new comment (optionally attached to a node).

parameters.name: file_key
parameters.description: File key. Can be found in Figma URL: https://www.figma.com/file/{FILE_KEY}/...

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The comment or reply text.

parameters.name: parent_comment_id
parameters.description: Parent comment ID to reply to. If provided, creates a reply. Default is None.

parameters.name: node_id
parameters.description: Node ID to attach the comment to. Ignored for replies. Default is None.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: X position offset on the node. Only used with node_id. Default is None.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Y position offset on the node. Only used with node_id. Default is None.

message.value: This button color needs to be adjusted to match the brand guidelines.

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: AddCommentReaction
tools.description:
React to a comment in a Figma file.

Reactions are how a thread gets triaged, since Figma exposes no way to resolve one.

parameters.name: file_key
parameters.description: File key. Can be found in Figma URL: https://www.figma.com/file/{FILE_KEY}/...

parameters.name: comment_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the comment to react to.

parameters.name: emoji
parameters.description: Emoji shortcode in colon-delimited form, for example :shortcode:.

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: CreateDevResources
tools.description:
Attach links to nodes in a Figma file.

Figma accepts each link independently, so some may be created while others are
rejected. Both outcomes are reported.

parameters.name: file_key
parameters.description: File key. Can be found in Figma URL: https://www.figma.com/file/{FILE_KEY}/...

parameters.name: links
parameters.description: Links to attach. Each needs a node_id, a name, and a url. All are attached to the file named by file_key.

output.description: Links created, and any Figma rejected

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: DeleteComment
tools.description:
Delete a comment from a Figma file.

Deleting a top-level comment also removes its replies. Figma has no way to resolve a
thread, so deletion is how a finished thread is cleared.

parameters.name: file_key
parameters.description: File key. Can be found in Figma URL: https://www.figma.com/file/{FILE_KEY}/...

parameters.name: comment_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the comment to delete.

parameters.name: comment_id

tools.description:
Get specific nodes from a Figma file by their IDs.

tools.name: ModifyVariables
tools.description:
Create, update, and delete Figma variables, collections, and modes in one call.

Figma applies the whole batch or none of it. Entities created in the same call can
reference each other by the temporary ids you supply, and the response maps each of
those to the real id Figma assigned. Deleting a variable is permanent.

Requires a Figma Enterprise organization.

parameters.name: file_key
parameters.description: File key. Can be found in Figma URL: https://www.figma.com/file/{FILE_KEY}/...

parameters.name: variable_collections
parameters.description: Collections to create, update, or delete. Omit to leave collections alone.

parameters.name: variable_modes
parameters.description: Modes to create, update, or delete. Omit to leave modes alone.

parameters.name: variables
parameters.description: Variables to create, update, or delete. Omit to leave variables alone.

parameters.name: variable_values
parameters.description: Values to set per variable per mode. Omit to leave values alone.

output.description: Confirmation, and ids assigned to created entities

<Callout type="warning" title="Private OAuth app requirement">
The `projects:read` scope is **ONLY available in private Figma OAuth apps**. This scope is required for the navigation tools (`GetTeamProjects` and `GetProjectFiles`). 
If you need these navigation tools, you must create a private OAuth app through your Figma organization settings. All other tools work with public OAuth apps.
</Callout>

summary:
## Figma Toolkit

Arcade's Figma toolkit lets LLMs read, annotate, and manage Figma files, components, styles, variables, and dev resources through the Figma REST API.

## Capabilities

- **File & node inspection:** Retrieve file structure, pages, specific nodes, version history, and export frames/nodes as images (URLs valid ~14 days).
- **Comments & reactions:** Read, post, reply to, and delete comments; add or remove emoji reactions (reactions serve as the triage mechanism since Figma has no thread-resolve API).
- **Components, component sets & styles:** Fetch published components, component sets, and styles from individual files or team libraries; retrieve usage analytics and weekly insert/detach/apply trends (Enterprise only).
- **Design tokens (variables):** Read local and published variables with per-mode values; batch-create, update, or permanently delete variables, collections, and modes in a single atomic call (Enterprise only); query weekly bind/detach actions and cross-file usage (Enterprise only).
- **Dev resources:** Attach, retrieve, rename, repoint, and delete links connecting design nodes to code, tickets, or documents.
- **Team & project navigation:** List teams' projects and projects' files; identify files across editor types (Design, FigJam, Slides); inspect authenticated user profile.

## OAuth

This toolkit uses OAuth 2.0 via the **Figma** provider. See the [Arcade Figma auth provider docs](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/references/auth-providers/figma) for setup details.
